links.outcome: Transcription accuracy and audited documentation quality of scribe-generated emergency reports
links.effect: Mean transcription accuracy 93.9% and stable over 12 months; audited quality scores higher for Scribe-generated reports with a large effect size.
links.quote: Transcription accuracy remained high and stable throughout the study (mean: 93.9 %).

links.outcome: Documentation quality and benefit consistency across physicians using an ambient scribe
links.effect: Audits showed higher documentation quality scores for Scribe reports, with a large effect size and consistent improvements across physicians; consultations 21.8% shorter.
links.quote: Audits of clinical reports showed higher documentation quality scores for Scribe-generated reports, with a large effect size and consistent improvements across physicians.

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment and impact of an ambient AI scribe across 48 hospitals on efficiency, documentation quality, and clinician/patient experience, but does not test a specific safeguard or deployment practice variation.
